messages:
Aisha: Quick question — onboarding gpt-like-v3: when converting HF generation_config.json to Redwood defaults, repetition_penalty (1.2) seems to have no effect for chat templates. Also seeing token repetition around role markers. Anyone seen this?

Ravi: Hmm, interesting. Can you paste the gen config? Also is the model quantized?

Aisha: Here's the gen config snippet from the HF repo:```json
{
  "max_length": 512,
  "temperature": 0.8,
  "top_p": 0.9,
  "top_k": 50,
  "repetition_penalty": 1.2,
  "do_sample": true,
  "eos_token_id": 50256
}
```
Model is 4-bit PTQ (we pushed a quantized artifact yesterday).

Sara: Two quick checks: 1) Our HF->Redwood mapper rewrites chat templates by concatenating system/user/assistant with special tokens — that can split tokens and dilute rep_penalty across pieces. 2) repetition_penalty is only effective if the sampling path injects it into the logits scorer; if mapping accidentally switches to nucleus-only without the scorer hook, rp is never applied.

Ravi: Also: quantization rescales logits; after PTQ the effective temperature changes. If you don't retune temperature/top_p after quant, sampling can look more repetitive even with rep_penalty.

Aisha: Ok — short actionable list so I don't miss anything: a) force do_sample + rep_penalty in the Redwood mapping, b) prefer a single compact role-delim token instead of verbose markers, c) retune temperature/top_p after quant. Which order?

Sara: Do c) first (get sampling behaviour back to baseline), then a). Change template (b) only if you can standardize it across other models. I'll push a small converter patch to ensure rep_penalty injection is preserved across chat wrappers. :thumbsup:

Ravi: Also add a regression test: feed a repetitive prompt and assert repetition metric improves when repetition_penalty > 1.0. Keeps future regressions from slipping in.

deploy-bot: NOTE: created issue RED-ml/742 for HF->Redwood genconfig edge-case (assigned to Sara): https://git.internal/redwood/RED-ml/742
